 The Kansas City Current will have its final home game against the Washington Spirit this weekend. The club hopes to bring 18,000 people to the stadium for its fan appreciation match. 
 Advertisement Updated: 5:00 PM CDT Oct 23, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ By Jaden Miller Kansas City Current looks to make history
 The Kansas City Current will have its final home game against the Washington Spirit this weekend. The club hopes to bring 18,000 people to the stadium for its fan appreciation match. 
 Updated: 5:00 PM CDT Oct 23, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ By Jaden Miller KANSAS CITY, Mo. — The KC Current is hoping to break attendance records for its final regular-season home match this weekend. 
 The team's goal is to have 18,000 fans in attendance as part of what it's calling "One Current 2026: Bigger Home. Bigger Future."
 Advertisement Match tickets are sold out, but grounds passes are still available for $10 a piece. 
 The $10 ticket gives fans a chance to enjoy live music, food trucks and family-friendly activities like games, inflatable obstacle courses and more at Current Landing. 
 Other fan activations feature trading cards, face painting, custom merch, giveaways, photo opportunities and more. 
 Plus, there will be a viewing party of the match on a large videoboard, allowing fans outside of the stadium to experience the matchday energy. 
 For those with a ticket, the first 10,000 fans to the stadium will get an exclusive KC Current flag.
 The first 5,500 inside the stadium will get a Debinha bobblehead. 
 The match begins at 4 p.m. Sunday. 
 For more information about the match and activity schedule, visit the Current's website here .
